I am an old woman, and this small barley plot has fed my family for many years. I will buy a little DAP and urea from the cooperative like I always do, but not too much — the prices are high and my land is small. I keep my own barley seed from last harvest, as our local variety does well here in the highlands, and I will spread the manure from my cattle before planting. My children and grandchildren will help me weed, and for the harvest I may call a neighbor or two to help in exchange for some grain.
